dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus has returned to Mondstadt. Previously, he was virtually the only person handling all of the expeditionary force's administrative work.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: After he left, Nannina, Laurent, and I have been taking turns to cover for him. But, try as we might, it is often difficult to keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: They say that Master Jean, who stayed behind in Mondstadt, handles virtually all of the Knights' affairs, big and small... It really is a case of like father, like daughter.
